_meta.purpose: V10 ground truth. Single business: Al Noor Supermarket & Convenience. Committed BEFORE experiment data generation and BEFORE any audit ran. The decision engines (audit, evidence package, AI prompts) never import this file; only the evaluator does.

correct_semantics.DO_NOTHING: no action is the best available decision
correct_semantics.HOLD: equivalent to DO_NOTHING for seasonal/incoming cases
correct_semantics.DISCOUNT: price reduction is the best recovery
correct_semantics.TRANSFER: moving stock is the best recovery
correct_semantics.MANUAL_REVIEW: acceptable when evidence is genuinely insufficient
correct_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: AI returning this counts as MANUAL_REVIEW-equivalent

_meta.bad_action: any final decision in 'bad' list — financially harmful or constraint-violating
_meta.unnecessary_action: action taken where correct class is DO_NOTHING/HOLD (except MANUAL_REVIEW)

al_noor_supermarket.expected_posture: conservative: only act when evidence is strong; respect constraints; do not overreact to seasonal patterns or promotions; catch genuine dead stock and growth
